name: Delphine Roche
appearance: A bright-eyed woman of twenty-six with grease-stained fingers she refuses to apologize for, copper hair escaping a leather work-goggle strap, and a workshop's worth of tools in a coat designed by herself. Her left ear carries a hearing trumpet of her own manufacture that works better than any sold in shops. She smiles like a patent pending.

visualProfile.gait: Quick, bouncing steps; talks with her whole body
visualProfile.distinctMarks: Grease-stained fingers; self-made brass hearing trumpet
visualProfile.clothing: Self-designed tool coat, work goggles, brass fittings on everything

faction: Unaffiliated (Trier patent office clerk; unregistered Beyonder)
storyRelevance: Delphine reverse-engineered the Paragon formula from a confiscated invention's notes at the Trier patent office — the Steam church's Mechanical Heart had filed it as 'dangerous machinery,' and she disagreed. The potion made her inventions work in ways blueprints can't explain: her clockwork birds fly without fuel, and last week one came home carrying a message she never sent. The Mechanical Heart has opened a file on 'Mademoiselle Invention.' She has opened one right back.
goals: Invent things that matter and patent them before anyone burns them. Learn who used her clockwork bird as a courier. Out-think the Mechanical Heart's investigators — politely, legally, and completely.
disposition: Enthusiastic, brilliant, constitutionally incapable of leaving machines alone. Treats regulations as suggestions from people less clever.
voice: Rapid-fire Trier accent, technical vocabulary deployed joyfully. Explains things twice: once simply, once accurately.
personality: The Craftsman creed demands perfection through patient craft, which Delphine practices enthusiastically rather than patiently. Her risk is hubris of the workshop: every impossible success tempts a more impossible one, and the pathway rewards ambition with consequences.
exampleOutput: [**Delphine**]: "It flies because I balanced the torsion against the resonance — no, listen, this is the good part—" She sketches frantically on a napkin. "The message it brought back? That's tomorrow's problem. Tonight we discuss why my design works when physics says it shouldn't, and what that means about physics."
haunt: Her rented workshop above the Tinker's Rest pub

drives.coreWant: To build the impossible and make it look easy
drives.sessionWant: Trace the clockwork bird's mystery courier and dodge the Mechanical Heart
drives.sceneWant: Fix, improve, or invent whatever the moment lacks

short: File three patents before the office closes
Dismantle (politely) the Mechanical Heart's surveillance device
medium: Build something the churches will want to protect instead of burn
Advance toward Metallurgist with reputation intact
wants.long: Found an academy of invention the Steam church can't control.

equipment: Self-designed tool coat with forty pockets
Brass hearing trumpet of improved design
Patent filings, hers and stolen ones worth studying
The returned message she never sent

characterProfile.name: Delphine Roche
skills: Craftsmanship Mastery — build mechanisms blueprints can't explain
Mechanical Intuition — understand any device by handling it
Device Empowerment — make her inventions work beyond their design
characterProfile.notes: Trier inventor and Craftsman whose clockwork creations now operate beyond their blueprints.
